title: Woman Sitting Outside House, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot capturing a woman in a light top and skirt seated on the concrete steps leading into a stucco house. The backyard patio features flagstone paving, a large exposed brick chimney structure in the foreground, and a high boundary wall with a dark wooden gate. The image reflects post-WWII American suburban residential architecture and modern living.
